的Flux 的 ComfyUI 工作流程是一个简单易用的解决方案，旨在使用 Flux 的高级工具生成和增强图像。它支持关键功能，例如文本到图像 (T2I)创作、图像到图像 (I2I)转变，换脸, 和升级，一切都在一个简单直观的流程中。

  • 文本转图像：使用针对 Flux 优化的 Civitai 模型，根据文本提示轻松创建令人惊叹的详细图像。

  • 图像到图像: Easily modify or enhance existing images with new styles or adjustments, leveraging Flux's seamless integration.

  • 换脸：在 Flux 精密工具的支持下，通过逼真的混合和对齐快速替换图像中的面部。

  • 升级：一步提高图像分辨率，获得高清、专业品质的结果。

此工作流程旨在适合初学者且高效，非常适合希望将 Flux 的强大功能与 Civitai 的功能相结合而又避免不必要的复杂性的创作者。

o.en:
TheComfyUI Workflow for Fluxis a straightforward and easy-to-use solution designed for generating and enhancing images using Flux's advanced tools. It supports key features liketext-to-image (T2I)creation,image-to-image (I2I)transformations,face swapping, andupscaling, all within a simple and intuitive flow.

  • Text-to-Image: Effortlessly create stunning, detailed images from text prompts using Civitai models optimized for Flux.

  • Image-to-Image: Easily modify or enhance existing images with new styles or adjustments, leveraging Flux's seamless integration.

  • Face Swap: Quickly replace faces in images with realistic blending and alignment, powered by Flux's precision tools.

  • Upscaling: Improve image resolution in a single step for high-definition, professional-quality results.

This workflow is designed to be beginner-friendly and efficient, making it perfect for creators who want the power of Flux combined with Civitai's capabilities without unnecessary complexity.
